title: NavigationPositionState
description: Supported certifies numeric game-coordinate position comparison only. A geometric preview must use exclusively this envelope's departure, destination and optional candidate positions at epochMs. Ordinary Viewer body/station meshes and stored positions remain unchanged, are not synchronized, and must not supply route points. Render destination/candidate positions as visibly distinct preview-only markers identified by solarSystemId plus marketId/bodyId and labeled as projected at epochMs (UTC or exact milliseconds), not as ordinary object positions. The route ends at destination.positionKm's projected marker, never at a different stored station mesh; any candidate waypoint uses its projected marker too. Respect previewEligibility: ineligible blocks the preview, eligible-with-warnings requires CLEARANCE_UNVERIFIED disclosure. No velocity compatibility, safety, clearance, transfer feasibility, or gravity-assist guarantee. Missing trusted ship lineage fails closed; no existing ships are backfilled. See docs/spatial-model.md for the presentation contract and actual local purchase/restart example; this contract does not add marker fields to the API.

coordinateBasisId.description: Numeric Sol catalog game basis: sol-sun root at zero, right-handed existing Cartesian seeder axes and parent-vector summation, X cross Y = Z. At zero orientation periapsis is +X, advancing anomaly moves toward +Y, and zero inclination lies in XY. Heliocentric source elements reference the J2000.0 ecliptic; satellite source planes are not independently normalized. Not physical barycentric coordinates or a new inertial/ephemeris guarantee.

epochMs.description: Verified unchanged ship position epoch. Every navigation position, including departure, destination, hostPositionKm and candidates, uses this common epoch, not request time, orbital-element reference epoch or older stored source epoch. Preview-only marker labels must identify this projection epoch.

kind.description: Production uses durable backend-controlled persisted purchase lineage. trusted-runtime-placement is test-only and does not establish a production issuance path.

lineageId.description: Stable committed purchase lineage identity, required for persisted placement.

marketId.description: Station identity within solarSystemId; associates the preview-only projected destination marker with the ordinary station without moving it. The route terminates at the projected positionKm, not its stored mesh.

hostBodyId.description: Exact verified host identity, not a substitute route endpoint or station position.

hostSourceEpochMs.description: Stored host position epoch, distinct from the common evaluated epochMs.

placementKind.description: Null preserves unknown placement kind for verified legacy orbital stations without metadata.

bodyId.description: Body identity within solarSystemId for a distinct preview-only marker at this candidate's positionKm and envelope epochMs. Any candidate waypoint uses that marker, not the ordinary stored body mesh. This is not a validated assist.

positionToleranceKm.description: Maximum Euclidean km discrepancy in source-position and trusted-placement checks; not a physical-accuracy claim.

previewEligibility.description: Separate from numeric position support. Known host-profile intersection blocks a route preview; eligible-with-warnings certifies no physical clearance.
